summary.intent: Fix hardcoded 'main'/'master' branch names in the TUI filter and ensure the TUI receives all queried sessions rather than a pre-filtered cap.
summary.outcome: Dynamic default branch detection via existing `getDefaultBranchFromRemote` was exposed publicly and wired into the TUI; the 10-row output cap was removed for TUI mode so all 200 queried sessions are passed through.

repo: getDefaultBranchFromRemote already existed in git_operations.go — checks refs/remotes/origin/HEAD first, then probes origin/main and origin/master as fallbacks.

outputLimit (default 10 via --last flag) was silently capping rows before they reached the TUI, masking the TUI's own Repo/CurrentBranch/All filter. The query limit (maxSummaryRecentSessions=200) and the TUI display limit were conflated.
RunWithCurrentBranch in summarytui/root.go accepts the defaultBranch string and threads it into the rootModel for use in applyFilter.

code.finding: Added public GetDefaultBranch wrapper around existing private getDefaultBranchFromRemote.
outputLimit cap was applied here before passing rows to TUI; now skipped when no CLI filters are active.
rootModel now carries defaultBranch field; applyFilter uses it instead of hardcoded string literals.

workflow: When a function already exists privately, prefer exposing it via a thin public wrapper rather than duplicating logic.
TUI components with their own filtering should receive the full dataset; pre-filtering before the TUI defeats the purpose of in-TUI filter controls.

friction: Multiple test call sites for newRootModel needed updating after adding the defaultBranch parameter — required several sequential edits across root_test.go and summary_cmd_test.go.
The --last flag was doing double duty (query limit + display cap) which was non-obvious and caused the bug in the first place.
open_items: The --last flag behavior is now split: it controls query count but not TUI display count. This asymmetry may confuse users or future contributors; consider renaming or documenting the distinction.

Files listed as modified in the transcript footer (settings.go, settings_test.go) don't match the changes described — may indicate the footer was stale or from a different change set; worth verifying.
